gaps.observation: The indexed command file is read as raw UTF-8, including frontmatter.
Only {{N}} placeholders are filled; $ARGUMENTS and native positional placeholders remain untouched.
Prompt assets and files are read as raw text and do not select an agent persona.
String commands are split on whitespace without shell parsing, so quoting and shell operators cannot be migrated mechanically.
Vendor-oriented built-in aliases and pass-through for known aliases missing a platform mapping remain active.
Only the AKM Markdown workflow frontend is executable; GitHub-shaped YAML has no runtime adapter.
